}}'''Norla''' was a [[wilder]] who once lived on a farm in the heart of the [[Black Hills]].{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Norla|Norla}}
==Appearance==
She was an old and toothless woman.{{Ref||Norla}}

==History==
Norla encountered [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] a short time after Cadsuane had been newly raised to the [[shawl]].  Cadsuane experienced a humbling lesson at the hands of Norla.  Norla also was the person who gave Cadsuane her various hair ornament ''[[angreal]]'' and ''[[ter'angreal]]''.{{ref/book|9|34}}{{ref/book|10|23}}
